description: Information system salt: planning basis, selection criteria and estimation of the potential for the construction of salt caverns for storing renewable energies (hydrogen and compressed air) - double saline and flat salt layers (InSpEE-DS) (WMS) is a dataset listed in EGDI Metadata Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by services.bgr.de. Which salt formations are suitable for storing hydrogen or compressed air? In the InSpEE-DS research project, scientists developed requirements and criteria for the assessment of suitable sites even if their exploration is still at an early stage and there is little knowledge of the salinaries’ structures. Coverage: Europe. Its keywords include inspireidentifiziert, Keuper, Energiespeicher, Deutschland, Kavernen, Erneuerbare Energien. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geology-cz.
